name: Carlo Pintacuda
features: olive skin, dark hair, dark eyes, broad open face, heavy brows, solid build, genial expression
bio: A Scuderia Ferrari road-racing specialist who won the Mille Miglia in 1935 and again in 1937, and took the Brazilian Grand Prix at Rio in 1937 and 1938. Pintacuda was the driver Ferrari sent when the race was long, rough and far from home.
